Author Graham Hancock joins Joe Rogan to talk about archaeological mysteries in the Amazon. Hancock is known for his claim that a lost high culture fell at the end of the Ice Age. The Amazon, in his view, hides some of its best proof.

Hancock lays out the finds in the rainforest that he says point to large, planned towns. He argues the jungle grew back over a world of roads, earthworks, and farms. Rogan draws out what new scans from the air have shown. Listeners get Hancock's Amazon case in a focused talk. The library holds the segment as an archive record.
